dex.text: Bolts out of the hedge in a blur of white tail, then acts as if it was never there. Nobody has ever caught one by tiptoeing up on it.
dex.fact: A rabbit's eyes sit on the sides of its head, giving it a field of view close to 360 degrees.

dex.text: Once a Scuttlet has got over its nerves it starts giving orders to the rest of the field, and the rest of the field tends to obey. Leaves the warren tidy, mostly.
dex.fact: The word warren comes from an Anglo-French term for an enclosure where rabbits were kept.
